description: This file defines policies and host information management for sandboxed processes in the Android Open Source Project, including directory setup, policy creation for various executables, and related utility functions.

classes.name: HostInfo
classes.description: A class encapsulating host environment paths and directory management functions.

methods.name: EnsureOutputDirectoriesExist
methods.description: Creates necessary output directories for host info, returning status.

methods.name: EnvironmentsUdsDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the environments Unix domain socket directory.

methods.name: HostToolExe
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a host tool executable.

methods.name: InstanceUdsDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the instance Unix domain socket directory.

methods.name: VsockDeviceDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the vsock device directory.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the stream insertion operator to output HostInfo details.
